title: Dino-Mite!
intro: [excited] ROAR! Welcome to the Dino-Mite episode, where tonight's clues are big, toothy, and about sixty-five million years overdue. [laughs] Don't worry, nobody here is going extinct... except maybe your score.

art.prompt: A sunlit prehistoric valley with towering ferns, a smoking volcano and a glowing comet streaking across an orange sky, giant fossil skeletons half-buried in a dig site with brushes, picks and lanterns in the foreground Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

categories.title: The Good, the Bad, and the Dino
categories.intro: Our film category stars a gentle giant who's afraid of, well, pretty much everything. [chuckles] Same, buddy. Same.

art.prompt: A rustic stone silo and a golden cornfield on a misty mountain farm at dawn, enormous dinosaur footprints pressed into the dirt path, a jagged snowy mountain range and a winding river behind Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: In The Good Dinosaur, this little human boy acts a lot like a pet dog.
clues.reveal: [cheerful] The correct answer is Spot! He sniffs, he howls, he fetches. Best boy. Literally.

clues.clue: Arlo is this kind of long-necked plant-eating dinosaur.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Apatosaurus! [laughs] Big neck, big heart, very big fear of chickens.

clues.clue: Arlo's family are farmers who store this crop in their silo.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is corn! [chuckles] A family of giant dinosaurs running a farm. Old MacDino had a farm, E I E I ROAR.

clues.clue: This gruff Tyrannosaurus rancher in The Good Dinosaur is voiced by Sam Elliott.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Butch! [whispers] That voice could make a cactus cry. Butch has a story for every scar.

clues.clue: This director, who also voices Forrest Woodbush, is credited with directing The Good Dinosaur.
clues.reveal: [impressed] The correct answer is Peter Sohn! He later directed Elemental too. Real Pixar paleontologists dug that one up.

categories.title: Jurassic Disney
categories.intro: Disney has been drawing dinosaurs since before your grandparents were born. [mischievously] Let's see who did their homework.

art.prompt: A dramatic mural-like scene of prehistoric silhouettes against a red volcanic sunset, an orchestra conductor's baton and sheet music floating in the smoky sky, a tropical island with lemur-shaped tree silhouettes on the horizon Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: In Toy Story, this nervous green Tyrannosaurus toy just wants to be scary.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Rex! [laughs] The only T. rex who's scared of confrontation. Relatable king.

clues.clue: Disney's 2000 film Dinosaur stars this young Iguanodon hero.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Aladar! [excited] Not to be confused with Aladdin. Fewer magic carpets, MORE meteors.

clues.clue: Fantasia's dinosaur segment is set to this ballet score by Igor Stravinsky.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Rite of Spring! [dramatic pause] The original 1913 ballet caused a near riot in Paris. Fantasia just added dinosaurs. Huge improvement.

clues.clue: In the movie Dinosaur, Aladar is raised on an island by a family of these primates.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is lemurs! [chuckles] Grandpa Yar and the gang. Sort of a dino-sized adoption story.

clues.clue: This ABC sitcom from 1991 to 1994, made with the Jim Henson Company, followed the Sinclair family of dinosaurs.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Dinosaurs! Baby Sinclair's catchphrase? NOT THE MAMA! [laughs] Every nerd just yelled it with me.

categories.title: Emoji-saurus
categories.intro: Name the Disney or Pixar movie from these emoji. [whispers] There's a dinosaur hiding in every single one.

art.prompt: A playful 3D cluster of glossy cartoon emoji-style bubbles shaped like dinosaur heads, corn cobs, comets and music notes floating over a jungle backdrop, bright candy colors Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: 🦖🤠🚀 Hint: playtime with a timid T. rex.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Toy Story! [cheerful] The very first Pixar feature, from 1995, and Rex has been panicking ever since.

clues.clue: 🦕🌽👦 Hint: a farm boy meets a wild boy.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Good Dinosaur! [chuckles] That corn emoji was doing a LOT of heavy lifting.

clues.clue: 🦕🐒☄️ Hint: a herd's long trek after a fiery fall from the sky.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Dinosaur! [excited] Released in 2000, it mixed computer-animated dinos with real filmed backgrounds.

clues.clue: 🦖🎩⏰ Hint: a time-traveling orphan and a bowler-hat villain.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Meet the Robinsons! [laughs] The T. rex gets mind-controlled by a hat. Keep moving forward, folks.

clues.clue: 🦖🎼🌋 Hint: no words, just an orchestra.
clues.reveal: [impressed] The correct answer is Fantasia! The 1940 original. Fantasia 2000 swapped dinosaurs for flamingos with a yo-yo.

categories.title: The Fossil Record
categories.intro: Time to dig into some real park photos! [sighs] Some of these spots have gone extinct, so pour one out for the dinos.

art.prompt: A paleontology dig pit at a sunny theme-park-style excavation site, chalk grid lines, half-exposed giant fossil ribs, rope barriers, field tents, brushes and a straw hat on a crate Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: This big green dinosaur on Echo Lake sells ice cream at which Walt Disney World park?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Disney's Hollywood Studios! [excited] That's Dinosaur Gertie, a tribute to the 1914 cartoon Gertie the Dinosaur. Ice cream of extinction, anyone?

clues.clue: This dino-themed land, pictured at its entrance, closed in 2026. Which park was it in?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Disney's Animal Kingdom! [sighs] DinoLand U.S.A. closed in February 2026 to make way for a new Tropical Americas area.

clues.clue: A replica of this long-necked dinosaur's skeleton towered over the bridge into DinoLand U.S.A.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Brachiosaurus! [chuckles] The original fossil cast lives at Chicago's Field Museum. Talk about a long neck for a long commute.

clues.clue: This was the home of the Dino Institute, where guests time-traveled on which thrill ride before it closed in 2026?
clues.reveal: [mischievously] The correct answer is DINOSAUR! Bonus fact: it opened in 1998 as Countdown to Extinction and was renamed in 2000.

clues.clue: This DinoLand quick-service restaurant, themed as a hangout for Dino Institute students, served its last burger in 2026.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Restaurantosaurus! Best pun in park history. [whispers] Gone, but never fossil-gotten.

categories.title: Rex Marks the Spot
categories.intro: Our wildcard is all about the most anxious dinosaur in toy history. [laughs] Deep breaths, Rex. Deep breaths.

art.prompt: A child's bedroom floor at toy scale: a plastic green toy dinosaur's shadow on a block tower, scattered building blocks, a toy treasure map with a big X, and a game controller, warm afternoon light Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: What color is Rex from Toy Story?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is green! [cheerful] Green with nerves, mostly.

clues.clue: This actor, famous for saying Inconceivable in The Princess Bride, voices Rex.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Wallace Shawn! [laughs] Inconceivable! A dinosaur who apologizes for roaring.

clues.clue: Bonnie's blue Triceratops toy, who becomes Rex's dino pal.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Trixie! [excited] She's into computers, which makes her the smartest dinosaur in the toy box.

clues.clue: In Toy Story 3, Rex and pals get stuck in this rough toddler room at Sunnyside Daycare.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Caterpillar Room! [sarcastic] Nothing says relaxing like toddlers using you as a drumstick.

clues.clue: In the 2014 TV special Toy Story That Time Forgot, Trixie meets a line of warrior dinosaur toys called these.
clues.reveal: [impressed] The correct answer is Battlesaurs! Led by Reptillus Maximus. [chuckles] True nerds watched the holiday specials.
